name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It regenerates details in the right places—faces, edges, textures—without blurring or artifacts, which directly boosts output quality. The trade-off is a 10-15% slowdown per frame, but that’s acceptable because EXCAVA’s bottleneck is still generation, not upscaling. This is the fastest way to squeeze 0.5%+ more usable power out of the system today.

name: Torque
text: InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop—it only sharpens existing noise, not the underlying synthetic face model’s bias. RealVisXL v1.1’s face model risks overfitting to synthetic faces, but its fine-tuned realism still beats generic upscalers for fidelity. Test both: run EXCAVA with InstantX upscaler on 100 frames, then with RealVisXL v1.1’s face model—compare face fidelity scores; the higher score wins.
